description: Source code for Kubernetes DaemonSet controller, managing daemon pods on nodes, including scheduling, updates, and status management.

classes.name: DaemonSetsController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing DaemonSet objects, scheduling pods on nodes, handling updates, deletions, and status synchronization.

methods.name: NewDaemonSetsController
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new DaemonSetsController with informers, clients, and configuration.

methods.name: storeDaemonSetStatus
methods.description: Updates the status subresource of a DaemonSet with current pod counts and conditions.

methods.name: NodeShouldRunDaemonPod
methods.description: Determines if a daemon pod should run on a given node based on node and daemonset conditions.

methods.name: predicates
methods.description: Checks if a daemon pod can run on a node considering node name, affinity, and taints.

methods.name: NewPod
methods.description: Creates a new daemon pod object for a specific node based on a DaemonSet template.

methods.name: getDaemonPods
methods.description: Retrieves daemon pods owned by a specific DaemonSet, handling adoption and orphaning.

methods.name: getNodesToDaemonPods
methods.description: Builds a map of nodes to daemon pods scheduled on them for a given DaemonSet.

methods.name: resolveControllerRef
methods.description: Resolves a controller reference to a DaemonSet object if it exists and matches.

methods.name: podsShouldBeOnNode
methods.description: Determines which daemon pods need to be created or deleted on a node to match the DaemonSet's desired state.

methods.name: manage
methods.description: Coordinates creation and deletion of daemon pods across nodes for a DaemonSet.

methods.name: syncNodes
methods.description: Creates or deletes daemon pods on specified nodes to match desired state.

methods.name: syncDaemonSet
methods.description: Main reconciliation loop for a DaemonSet, handling updates, status, and pod management.

methods.name: updateDaemonSet
methods.description: Handles updates to a DaemonSet, including rolling updates and history cleanup.

methods.name: updateDaemonSetStatus
methods.description: Calculates and updates the status of a DaemonSet based on current pods and nodes.

methods.name: syncNodeUpdate
methods.description: Processes node updates to ensure daemon pods are correctly scheduled or removed.
